_note: Versions locked in Gemfile.lock on main as of 2026-10-25 (2ea3478, after Phases 6–10). Latest published versions live in latest_versions.json (regenerate with fetch_latest_versions.py); newest release per minor line via gem_lines.py.

nokogiri.notes: 1.19.4 requires Ruby >= 3.2 (Phase 13). The Dockerfile pin must match the lockfile exactly or the pre-install is a no-op and libxml2 compiles from source (PR #229 finding).

pg.notes: Latest. Precompiled aarch64-linux / x86_64-linux gems with bundled libpq 18.6 and OpenSSL; declares Ruby >= 3.1, < 4.1, so it is the version carried through Phase 18. The image's libpq-dev is only a source-build fallback now.

puma.notes: Latest. config/puma.rb pins the bind host to 0.0.0.0 because puma 8 defaults to :: when any non-loopback IPv6 address exists; persistent_timeout is now 65 s (above the ALB's 60 s idle timeout, the recommended ordering).

devise.notes: Latest. config.secret_key is set explicitly from ENV['SECRET_KEY_BASE'] (config/initializers/devise.rb:11). Its recoverable tokens derive from ActiveSupport::KeyGenerator, which Phase 11's load_defaults 7.0 moves from SHA1 to SHA256.

jwt.notes: Latest. Strict Base64 decoding; spec/services/jwt_token_service_spec.rb covers the round trip and the error classes. JwtTokenService still reads Rails.application.secrets.secret_key_base — Phase 11 moves it to Rails.application.secret_key_base (same value in production).

bootstrap.notes: 5.3.8 is a design-breaking migration; standing note in upgrade_path.json. Its SCSS produces 307 Dart Sass deprecation warnings, hidden by config.sass.quiet_deps since Phase 9.

omniauth_rails_csrf_protection.notes: latest; drops ActiveSupport::Configurable, which Action Pack 8.1 removes

active_model_serializers.notes: latest; low-maintenance gem; declares support through Rails 8

haml.notes: 6.0 replaced the implementation with Hamlit and removed helpers (surround/succeed used in show.html.haml); 7.5.1 requires Ruby >= 3.2 (Phase 17). haml 6.4.0 (2025-10-28, Ruby >= 2.1) is the fallback if 5.2.2 breaks on Rails 7.1/7.2 before Phase 13.

dartsass_sprockets.notes: Latest. Replaced sass-rails 6.0.0 / sassc-rails 2.1.2 / sassc 2.4.0 (libsass). sass-embedded is locked at 1.102.0 because 1.103+ and every binary platform gem require Ruby >= 3.2; the generic gem downloads Dart Sass at bundle install. Moves to 1.106.x with the Phase 13 Ruby bump.

terser.notes: Latest. Replaced uglifier 4.1.11; production.rb sets config.assets.js_compressor = :terser.

sprockets.notes: latest 4.x; Propshaft is for new apps only and would need the CoffeeScript migration first (standing note)

rspec_rails.notes: 7.1.1 (last 7.x) for Rails 7.1/7.2 in Phase 11, 8.0.4 (2026-03-11) for Rails 8 in Phase 15

rubocop.source: Gemfile.lock (rubocop ~> 1.92, rubocop-rails 2.38.0, rubocop-rspec 3.10.2, rubocop-capybara 3.1.0, rubocop-factory_bot 2.28.0); Phase 10, PR #227
rubocop.notes: Latest. .rubocop.yml uses `plugins:`; TargetRubyVersion 3.1 with NewCops disable. 1.9x accepts TargetRubyVersion 3.4 and 4.0, which Phases 13 and 18 need (1.28 rejected anything above 3.2).

selenium_webdriver.notes: newest release admitting Ruby 3.1; 4.51.0 requires Ruby >= 3.3 (Phase 13); no spec is tagged js: true, so effectively unused

shoulda_matchers.notes: newest 6.x; 8.0.1 requires Ruby >= 3.3 (Phase 13). The chilled-string warnings seen in the Ruby 4.0 spike came from 5.3.0 and are gone.

annotaterb.source: Gemfile.lock; Phase 10, PR #227 (replaced annotate 3.2.0, which does not load on Rails 7.2+)
annotaterb.notes: latest; .annotaterb.yml reproduces the existing annotations byte for byte (classified_sort false)

pry.source: Gemfile.lock; spec/spec_helper.rb requires it first; Phase 10, PR #227
pry.notes: latest. 0.12.2 failed to load on Ruby >= 3.2 (Object#=~ removed) and took the whole suite with it — PR #229 finding, now cleared

byebug.notes: 13.0.0 needs Ruby 3.2 (Phase 13). 10.0.2 did not compile under Trixie's GCC 14 — PR #229 finding, now cleared

minitest.notes: declares Ruby < 4.0, which broke the frozen install in the Ruby 4.0 spike; 5.26+ (Ruby >= 3.1) dropped the cap. Expect Phase 11's bundle update to move it; confirm before Phase 18.
